notes.title: Patchnotes 2025-09-21
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45114156/95655f0500be389955d9522123e2f1aab248353c.png"]

Added physics to dropped items (physics are disabled when they come to a stop)

Removed cars from roads (they were not moving, anyway)

Added rocky shore area between city and temple area (was too much water before)

Moved traffic lights and signs across the street to change the traffic side (If there were moving cars, they would ride on the right side – which is the right one)
